TC-04/S21.detail: Reproduced twice. Reload with no wait after typing 'Bed 12, daughter updated, plan unchanged.': on reopening the box is empty and the server row is ''. Replacing it with '... Call back at 5.' and closing the tab at once: the new tab shows only the old sentence. No 'not saved' message either time.
TC-04/S21.productIssue: A physician who types into a Quick Dictation box and reloads or closes the tab within ~0.8 s loses the last words with no warning: the box comes back empty (or without 'Call back at 5.'). Breaks TC-04 U4 ('boxes are never silently dropped'). On main the pad saves on an 800 ms debounce (useQuickDictation) with no flush on unload and no device draft.
